steps: verify contract, instrument, protocol, reference-coordinate, and anchor-2 digests
select T_BH from the complete A0 grid
run a pilot p_mu collection with h=0.7, sigma=2.0, M=8, Tlo=0.05, Thi=0.20 and select pilot g_tol/g_tol_hill
select h and sigma from the complete A3 grid using the pilot gate values
select the A1/A6 ladder, then the acceptance-matched A7 ladder
repeat p_mu collection at the selected h, sigma, and A1 ladder; recompute g_tol/g_tol_hill and stop if either differs from the pilot value
select q_r, p_min, tau_bh, tau_pt, and diag_grad_budget from the final p_mu evidence
select MD integrator and matched B1/B2 proposal scales
select projected-Hessian finite-difference width and eigenvalue thresholds
run the final all-arm calibration probe and derive sham bands, k_max, and t_max_screen
derive delta_tie, validate all Contract B bindings, and write calibration raw/checkpoint/Contract B artifacts

stopping_rules.fixed_point: If final p_mu changes g_tol or g_tol_hill relative to the pilot selection, stop without iterating or choosing after inspection.
stopping_rules.no_partial_grid: No candidate may be selected until every candidate-seed cell required by its grid has a valid cached record.
stopping_rules.no_holdout: Any attempted seed outside 100-105 before anchor-4 is a fatal integrity error.
